official_sources.name: EA LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles

direct_official_checks: candidate identity and coordinate must come from canonical runtime descriptor
HMLR parcel geometry must remain in native BNG for binding
cross-local-authority duplicate polygons must be deduplicated before counting
EA numeric elevation must come from DTM coverage not WMS preview
NoData sentinel must be rejected as a measurement
survey epoch and vertical transformation metadata must be preserved
OS Terrain50 may corroborate broad-scale plausibility but not parcel precision
final uncertainty must keep correlated same-family raster checks separate from independent corroboration
quality_effect: Defines the fail-closed transaction that converts a real runtime descriptor into an auditable measurement or NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED.
